---
title: "Cyclistic Programme Monitor"
subtitle: "Annual members vs casual riders · Chicago Divvy · 2021–2025"
format:
  dashboard:
    theme: flatly
    orientation: rows
    embed-resources: true
    nav-buttons: []
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(tidyr)
  library(scales)
})

derived <- file.path("..", "data", "derived")
if (!file.exists(file.path(derived, "member_share.csv"))) {
  derived <- file.path("data", "derived")
}

member_share <- read_csv(file.path(derived, "member_share.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
programme_month <- read_csv(file.path(derived, "programme_month.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
quality_month <- read_csv(file.path(derived, "quality_month.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
timing <- read_csv(file.path(derived, "timing.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
duration_month <- read_csv(file.path(derived, "duration_month.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

pal <- c(member = "#215C8C", casual = "#C05621")
theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
)

n_trips <- sum(member_share$n_trips)
n_in <- sum(quality_month$n_in)
member_share_all <- sum(member_share$n_member) / n_trips
drop_rate <- 1 - n_trips / n_in

to_date <- function(ym) as.Date(paste0(ym, "-01"))
member_share$date <- to_date(member_share$year_month)
programme_month$date <- to_date(programme_month$year_month)
duration_month$date <- to_date(duration_month$year_month)
quality_month$date <- to_date(quality_month$year_month)
```

## Headline {height="18%"}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Kept trips"
list(
  icon = "bicycle",
  color = "primary",
  value = comma(n_trips)
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Member trip share"
list(
  icon = "person-badge",
  color = "secondary",
  value = percent(member_share_all, accuracy = 0.1)
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Records dropped"
list(
  icon = "shield-exclamation",
  color = "warning",
  value = percent(drop_rate, accuracy = 0.1)
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Months"
list(
  icon = "calendar3",
  color = "light",
  value = nrow(member_share)
)
```

## Mix and volume {height="42%"}

### Member share of trips (Wilson 95% interval)

Share of **trips**, not unique people. Divvy files have no rider id.

```{r}
ggplot(member_share, aes(date, member_share)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high), fill = "#215C8C", alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(colour = "#215C8C", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
```

### Monthly volume by programme

```{r}
ggplot(programme_month, aes(date, n_trips, colour = member_casual)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
```

## When and how long {height="40%"}

### Weekday × hour (members)

```{r}
heat <- timing |>
  group_by(member_casual, weekday, hour) |>
  summarise(n_trips = sum(n_trips), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    weekday = factor(
      weekday,
      levels = c("Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday")
    )
  )

ggplot(
  dplyr::filter(heat, member_casual == "member"),
  aes(hour, weekday, fill = n_trips)
) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F4F7FA", high = "#215C8C", name = "Trips") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 23, 3)) +
  labs(x = "Hour", y = NULL)
```

### Weekday × hour (casual)

```{r}
ggplot(
  dplyr::filter(heat, member_casual == "casual"),
  aes(hour, weekday, fill = n_trips)
) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F4F7FA", high = "#C05621", name = "Trips") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 23, 3)) +
  labs(x = "Hour", y = NULL)
```

### Median duration (minutes)

```{r}
ggplot(duration_month, aes(date, duration_median_min, colour = member_casual)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
```
